name: Little Colt
log_25: Research Log, Day 1: We put an oat in the centrifuge. It is spinning very fast. Nobody knows why we did this.
log_50: Research Log, Day 40: The hay has started humming. We have stopped asking questions.
log_75: Research Log, Day 91: Dr. Oppenhay-mer has not slept. He keeps muttering about splitting the haystack.
armed_text: 🔴 **Little Colt is ARMED.** It's sitting on a pallet behind the stables, ticking. Anyone with the nerve can `!launch` it.
detonation_text: A flash brighter than the Casino sign. A mushroom cloud shaped suspiciously like a horse's head. Somewhere, a foal is born glowing.

name: Fat Mare
log_25: Research Log: Little Colt was a proof of concept. Fat Mare is a statement. We have doubled the oats.
log_50: Research Log: The geiger counter is now just making horse noises.
log_75: Research Log: Fat Mare no longer fits through the barn door. We have removed the barn.
armed_text: 🔴 **Fat Mare is ARMED.** She's enormous, she's angry, and she's one `!launch` away from going off.
detonation_text: The ground shakes for a full minute. Every horse in town whinnies at once. The Front is a glass parking lot now.

name: The Hay-drogen Bomb
log_25: Research Log: Fission was for amateurs. We are fusing two bales of hay together. The bales did not consent.
log_50: Research Log: Containment has been described by legal as 'a fence'.
log_75: Research Log: The reaction is self-sustaining. So is the smell.
armed_text: 🔴 **The Hay-drogen Bomb is ARMED.** This one's thermonuclear. Somebody `!launch` it before it gets ideas.
detonation_text: A second sun rises over the Ranch and sets again, embarrassed. The fallout smells like a barn that caught fire on purpose.

name: Czar Bom-bray
log_25: Research Log: Our foreign counterparts are building something bigger. We will build something bigger than that.
log_50: Research Log: It brays when you walk past it. We think that's normal.
log_75: Research Log: Experts recommend we stop. The experts have been fed to the bomb.
armed_text: 🔴 **Czar Bom-bray is ARMED.** The biggest horse bomb ever built. Each one costs more than the last. `!launch` it.
detonation_text: The bray is heard three servers over. When the dust settles, the research team is already asking for a bigger budget.
